title: Formal letter shell
back: Sender's address → date → receiver → subject → Sir, → P1 purpose · P2 details · P3 action → Yours sincerely, name.

title: P-D-A paragraphs
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Three paragraphs of about 45 words each" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="40" width="240" height="34" rx="4" fill-opacity="0.2"/><rect x="40" y="82" width="240" height="34" stroke="#E0B400" rx="4" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.2"/><rect x="40" y="124" width="240" height="34" rx="4" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="160" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">P1 Purpose — why I write</text><text x="160" y="104" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">P2 Details — 2–3 concrete points</text><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">P3 Action — what I want, politely</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Three paragraphs of about 45 words each</text></svg>
back: Purpose, Details, Action. P2 is where the content marks live: places, dates, numbers, effects.

title: Editor letter opener
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Receiver: The Editor, paper, city · Salutation: Sir," fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="60" width="70" height="46"/><path d="M40,60 L75.0,85.3 L110,60"/><rect x="130" y="40" width="170" height="70" rx="8"/><path d="M146,110 l-6,10 l14,-10"/><text x="215.0" y="55" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Through the columns of your</text><text x="215.0" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">esteemed newspaper I wish to</text><text x="215.0" y="79" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">draw attention to…</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Receiver: The Editor, paper, city · Salutation: Sir,</text></svg>
back: Open with the esteemed-newspaper line, give two or three specifics, name who should act, end hoping for prompt action. Never *Dear Editor*.

title: Complaint essentials
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Firm and polite — facts, not anger" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="50" y="40" width="220" height="110" rx="6"/><text x="160" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">item · date of purchase</text><text x="160" y="80" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">bill / order number</text><text x="160" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">exact defect · inconvenience</text><text x="160" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">ONE remedy within a time frame</text><text x="160" y="136" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">bill enclosed</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Firm and polite — facts, not anger</text></svg>
back: P2 must carry the transaction details and the defect; P3 asks for replacement / repair / refund within a period. Threats cost expression marks.

title: Covering letter + bio-data
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Two separate blocks, not one mixed letter" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="30" y="40" width="120" height="120" rx="4"/><text x="90" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Covering letter</text><text x="90" y="85" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">advert → suitability</text><text x="90" y="100" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">→ interview</text><text x="90" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Encl.: Bio-data</text><path d="M155,100 L175,100 M168.7,103.0 L175,100 L168.7,97.0"/><rect x="180" y="40" width="110" height="120" rx="4"/><text x="235" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">BIO-DATA</text><text x="235" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Name · DOB</text><text x="235" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Address · Contact</text><text x="235" y="108" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Qualifications</text><text x="235" y="121" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Experience · Skills</text><text x="235" y="134" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Languages</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Two separate blocks, not one mixed letter</text></svg>
back: Short covering letter (advert reference, suitability, enclosure, interview request) then a separate BIO-DATA block with name, DOB, address, contact, qualifications table, experience, skills, languages.

title: Marks split 1 + 2 + 2
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Content and expression share four of five" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="40" y="70" width="48.0" height="40" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="64.0" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Format 1</text><rect x="88.0" y="70" width="96.0" height="40" stroke="#E0B400" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="136.0" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Content 2</text><rect x="184.0" y="70" width="96.0" height="40" stroke="#E0B400" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.2"/><text x="232.0" y="95" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Expression 2</text><text x="160.0" y="50" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">5 marks</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Content and expression share four of five</text></svg>
back: Format 1 · Content 2 (points asked, specific) · Expression 2 (register, cohesion, grammar, 120–150 words).

title: Sir, not Dear Editor
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Editor → Sir,  ·  Offices → Sir/Madam," fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><text x="100" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Dear Editor,</text><path d="M78,66 L122,66" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="2"/><text x="220" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Respected Sir,</text><path d="M198,66 L242,66" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="2"/><rect x="90" y="100" width="60" height="36" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="120.0" y="122.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Sir,</text><rect x="170" y="100" width="90" height="36" rx="6" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.25"/><text x="215.0" y="122.2" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Sir/Madam,</text><text x="160.0" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Editor → Sir,  ·  Offices → Sir/Madam,</text></svg>
back: The receiver line already says *The Editor*; the salutation is simply *Sir,*. Over-formal or chatty salutations lose the format mark.

title: Subject line in one phrase
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Name the matter in a few words" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="28" y="40" width="264" height="90" rx="10" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="160" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Subject: …</text><text x="160" y="155" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">one phrase names the matter</text></svg>
back: Name the matter in a few words, e.g. 'Subject: Replacement of a defective fan'. The body then follows.
